description: Use for "where is the arbitrage" and "Kalshi vs Polymarket price gaps". Cross-venue gaps on the same sports contract (NBA, NHL, MLB, World Cup) against Polymarket's international book: the gap in pp, the WATCH/ARB signal and the cheaper venue. Free: the largest gap in full. One email returns the top 3; Pro returns the whole board.

minGap.description: Minimum gap in percentage points to include (default 3 = WATCH threshold). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("3", "3pp", "3%").
